title: Pricing Page
content: Build pricing page with plan comparison. Header: title "Simple, Transparent Pricing", toggle for monthly/annual billing. Plan cards: 3 tiers side by side (Basic, Pro, Enterprise). Card structure: plan name, price (large), billing period, description, feature list with check icons, CTA button. Popular badge: highlight recommended tier. Enterprise: "Contact Sales" instead of price. Feature comparison table below. FAQ section at bottom.

variants.simple: Create pricing page with tier comparison cards and feature lists.

variants.advanced: Build comprehensive pricing page with comparison and conversion focus. Page header: text-center py-12, headline "Simple, Transparent Pricing" (text-4xl font-bold), subheadline "Choose the plan that fits your needs" (text-xl text-gray-600). Billing toggle: inline-flex items-center gap-4, "Monthly" label, toggle switch (bg-blue-600 when annual), "Annual" label with "Save 20%" badge (bg-green-100 text-green-800 text-xs px-2 py-0.5 rounded-full). Plan cards: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-8 max-w-6xl mx-auto. Card structure: bg-white rounded-2xl shadow-lg p-8, border-2 (border-transparent default, border-blue-600 for popular). Popular tier: relative with "Most Popular" badge (absolute -top-4 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 bg-blue-600 text-white text-sm px-4 py-1 rounded-full), slightly larger scale (scale-105), shadow-xl. Plan name: text-lg font-semibold text-gray-600. Price: flex items-baseline gap-1, price number (text-5xl font-bold), period ("/month" text-gray-500). Annual pricing: show monthly equivalent with "billed annually" note. Description: text-gray-600 mt-4. Feature list: space-y-4 mt-8. Each feature: flex items-center gap-3, Check icon (text-green-500), feature text. Unavailable features: X icon (text-gray-300), text-gray-400 line-through. CTA button: w-full mt-8, primary style for popular tier, outline for others. Enterprise card: "Custom" price, "Contact Sales" button, include custom features text. Feature comparison table: full-width below cards, responsive horizontal scroll on mobile. Table: feature names left column, plan columns right, Check/X icons or values in cells. Category headers: bold rows spanning full width. Sticky first column on scroll. FAQ section: max-w-3xl mx-auto py-16, accordion style. Trust elements: customer logos, testimonials, money-back guarantee badge. Mobile: cards stack vertically, popular card first. Accessibility: toggle announced, feature list properly structured.
